build_gradient_boosting_classifier: build a GradientBoostingClassifier with subsample less than 1.0 to enable out-of-bag estimates
compute_oob_improvement: compute out-of-bag improvement estimates from a fitted GradientBoostingClassifier to find optimal iterations
run_cross_validation_estimate: run k-fold cross-validation to estimate test loss for a GradientBoostingClassifier
plot_oob_test_cv_losses: plot OOB, test, and cross-validation loss curves to compare model performance across iterations
score_gradient_boosting_classifier: score a fitted GradientBoostingClassifier on test data to evaluate accuracy
